independence: Reviewer authored integrator, not this artificial test or archive module. Review scope is the test source and its ability to exercise original routes; integrator itself has separate different-author review.
review_method: Initial full source read plus exact final diff against history_before_nms_mode_checks, final relevant blocks and all seven candidate identities checked. No test execution.

checks.name: original_route_not_replaced
checks.source_reason: Nine original pipeline AST methods, original utility do_sample/encoders/PIL conversion and complete original Navigator class are used; original model constructor/top-level import are excluded explicitly.

checks.name: plain_vs_observed
checks.source_reason: Independent plain calls original initialize/left/right directly; observed calls integration.run_original with same fixture builders and seed 42 for Python, NumPy and Torch. Final snapshots compare exact pixels/cache/map/poses/IDs/counts/RNG.

checks.name: delegate_identity_and_order
checks.source_reason: Tests original first returned live history-list alias, initial and final returned PIL identities; separately tests synchronous first-return archive has five frames before the alias grows to nine.

checks.name: all_slots_and_cache
checks.source_reason: All eight actual fixture sample/latent slots, seven/four full target embeddings, 1/5/9 caches, depth 5/9 and focal 5/14 are read back and compared with values captured inside the independent fixture callbacks.

checks.name: sampler_mutation_and_rng
checks.source_reason: Fixture captures incoming noise/conditions/RNG before deliberately mutating noise and consuming Python/NumPy/Torch randomness; archive sampler input/output must match these observations.

checks.name: original_cond_and_nms
checks.source_reason: Original get_cond and NMS route execute. Small zero-ray/render/retrieval replacements are explicit leaves, not a replacement of context selection or original generation loop.

checks.name: failure_prefix
checks.source_reason: Same original exception instance is raised in the second artificial sampler after random consumption. Plain/observed partial state and RNG must agree; no second samples/cache/map/navigator return is accepted.

checks.name: hook_restoration
checks.source_reason: All actual patched instance methods/module aliases are snapshotted by object identity and required restored in successful and failure cases.

checks.name: persistent_nms_delta
checks.source_reason: Final delta includes persistent initial_threshold in plain/observed state; archive checks ten already-computed sorted distances, zero-based index five and exact saved threshold, with actual returned context IDs and successful second-scene IDs. No additional geodesic calculation.

checks.name: grad_mode_delta
checks.source_reason: Both grad_enabled and inference_mode are saved before/after each case, required restored within each route and compared across plain/observed; existing local decode/construct guards retained.

checks.name: pre_factory_rejection
checks.source_reason: One explicit synthetic rejecting callback proves trace/archive/runtime factories were not invoked and original exception was preserved. It is not claimed as the real resource-readiness check.

checks.name: fixed_scope_and_barriers
checks.source_reason: Exact seven-source contract, fresh output, explicit synthetic evidence, final unchanged-source check, CPU1/120s/2GiB declared for external supervision. No real 50-step sampler, model/GA/renderer or quality claim.

findings_closed.finding: Persistent NMS threshold and actual saved selection not asserted beyond event counts
findings_closed.resolution: Added unchanged-state and ten-distance/index-five/actual-ID comparisons in existing success/failure cases.

findings_closed.finding: Global grad/inference mode restoration not checked at route exit
findings_closed.resolution: Added before/after mode values and exact within-route/across-route checks without adding scenarios.

limits: Passing source review does not mean tests passed; root must freeze and execute with the external budget.
Tiny components and two artificial steps test wiring and archival, not original VMem numerical behavior or 50/400-step success.
The fixture uses zero translation and synthetic ray/geometry/render/retrieval leaves; no video quality or long-memory conclusion.
